integrity: Renewal mean already published; original assertion is the sharp monotonicity threshold and exact Bernstein rational certificate. Standalone verifier uses SymPy for exact polynomial reconstruction and rational arithmetic. Independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional Brownian half-line diffusion with Poisson resets to the same point, fixed integer reset allowance and exhaustion at the next alarm. Only unconditional termination time is classified; no claim of uniqueness of rate extrema or of transport to other search protocols.
title: The exact reset-budget threshold for nonmonotone Brownian search termination
